本次公网探测通过；仍需验证用户实际访问的公司业务。: Public probes passed; still verify the actual company service the user needs.
部分网络探测未通过，请结合公司网络策略复核下方证据。: Some probes did not pass. Review the evidence against company network policy.
代理路径的网页探测失败，直连探测成功：核对公司代理地址、认证和准入策略；未经批准: The proxy web probe failed while the direct probe passed. Check the company proxy, authentication and access policy; do not disable it without approval.
本机代理路径探测失败：核对公司 VPN 或代理客户端的运行与认证状态，再按内部运: The local proxy probe failed. Check the company VPN or proxy client and its authentication, then follow internal support procedures.
公网 IP 探测成功但域名解析失败：核对公司指定的 DNS、VPN 和域名策略；: Public IP access passed but DNS failed. Check company DNS, VPN and domain policies; do not switch directly to public DNS.
IP 与 DNS 探测成功，但网页探测失败：核对公司代理、证书、访问控制和目标站: IP and DNS probes passed but web access failed. Check company proxy, certificates, access policy and target availability; one probe does not prove system corruption.
网关可达，公网探测失败：核对出口策略、上游链路与网络准入；不要直接重启公司路由器: The gateway responded but public probes failed. Check egress policy, upstream connectivity and network admission; do not immediately reboot company routers or reset the PC network.
网关探测未成功：核对网线、Wi-Fi、地址和 VLAN；网关也可能禁止 ICMP: The gateway probe did not pass. Check cabling, Wi-Fi, addressing and VLAN; ICMP may be blocked, so compare other evidence.
